posts.zh:
dsh-auth-tunnel 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。通过快速或命名 Cloudflare Tunnel 为 DSH Web GUI 提供密码保护的公网访问，并代理 HTTP/WebSocket 流量、改用应用内目录选择器。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-4282ddc21f61f1466fa9.html
posts.en:
dsh-auth-tunnel is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Password-gated public access for the DSH Web GUI through quick or named Cloudflare Tunnels, with HTTP/WebSocket proxying and an in-app directory picker.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-4282ddc21f61f1466fa9.html
